This page is the source list for Admin cost analytics. Each provider row names
the posted-cost source (an invoice or billing export), the usage source (an API
that meters consumption), the collector credential it needs and the
team that owns the account. Credentials are referenced by environment variable
name only.

The reconciliation rules that turn this evidence into Admin numbers live in
`apps/infrastructure/src/lib/admin-costs/README.md`. Reviewed invoices land in
`private.external_provider_invoices`. A root-workspace invoice whose provider,
account and app have a Finance destination in
`private.usage_finance_destinations` posts to that expense category through
`private.post_usage_provider_invoice`; other invoices stay unposted. Run-level
and account-day provider costs land in `private.external_provider_costs`.

## API-reported charges

Snapshot taken 2026-11-21 from read-only provider billing APIs. These are
provider-reported charges, not issued-invoice totals: an open month is still
accruing and a closed month becomes a posted cost only after its invoice is
reconciled. Amounts are USD, rounded to the dollar, and cover the whole
provider account.

| Provider | Scope and source field | Oct 2026 | Nov 2026, through 19 Nov |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GitHub | Organization billing usage, `netAmount` | $32 | $10 |
| Vercel | Team FOCUS charges, `BilledCost` | $33 | $26 |

GitHub's charge is GitHub Secret Protection seats for the organization. Actions
minutes and storage are fully discounted for the public repository, so their
`grossAmount` is list-price exposure rather than spend; it would become spend
if the repository turned private or jobs moved to larger hosted runners.
Self-hosted macOS runners cost machine time outside GitHub billing.

Vercel's charge is the Pro plan plus usage after included credit. Per-project
and per-service detail stays in Admin, not in this public page.

Every other provider has no reported figure yet; see
[Coverage gaps](#coverage-gaps).

## Provider inventory

Owner names the team accountable for the account and its collector credential.
`COST_*` names are proposed collector bindings, each a separate credential
that never shares a token with deploy, runtime or payment paths. The collector
only makes read calls. Where a provider offers no read-only credential (OpenAI
and Anthropic admin keys, the AI Gateway API key), the row says so and the key
is held only by the collector.

| Provider | What we use | Posted cost source | Usage source | Collector credential (scope) | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cloudflare | Configured in repo (some held from publication; see the [adoption inventory](/build/development-tools/oxc-cloudflare-adoption)): Workers (gateway, api, about 30 Start apps), Durable Objects (meet-realtime, colab, chat-realtime, abuse-guard, ops-hub, coordination, cron-control, roadmap, deploy-coordinator, devbox-control, mastermind-store, turbo-cache, parley), R2 (meet, parley, lettin, turbo-cache, mail), D1 (lettin), KV (status-api), Queues (ops-hub), Images (meet, parley), Stream, Realtime SFU and TURN, Analytics Engine, Rate Limiting, Email Service, Cloudflare for SaaS, Turnstile, Access | Invoice from the dashboard; Billing API billing history | GraphQL Analytics API per product, priced on each product's billable metric (for example, Images bindings bill unique monthly transformations, so daily request counts cannot be priced directly) | `COST_CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` (account token: Account Analytics Read, Billing Read) | Infrastructure |
| Vercel | Hosting for apps still on Vercel, Analytics, Speed Insights, Blob, Turbo remote cache, AI Gateway | Team invoice | FOCUS charges `GET /v1/billing/charges` (daily rows tagged by project) | `COST_VERCEL_API_TOKEN` (team-scoped token with billing read) | Infrastructure |
| Vercel AI Gateway | Model traffic for Mira, Meet AI and AI Studio | Credit top-up receipts | Dashboard credit balance (manual); the Gateway credit endpoint needs a Gateway API key, not the billing token. `ai_credit_transactions` priced from `ai_gateway_models` is attribution evidence to reconcile against Gateway charges | Invoice import; `COST_AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY` (not read-only: it can also send model requests) if the credit endpoint is adopted | AI platform |
| Supabase | Production, staging and qualify projects in one organization | Organization invoice | Management API project and add-on inventory | `COST_SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN` (scoped token: `organization_projects_read`, `infra_add_ons_read`) | Infrastructure |
| GitHub | Actions (hosted Linux, macOS and Windows), Actions storage, Git LFS, Secret Protection | Organization receipt or invoice | `GET /organizations/{org}/settings/billing/usage` (daily SKU rows with gross, discount and provisional net amounts) | `COST_GITHUB_TOKEN` (fine-grained token: organization Administration read) | Infrastructure |
| Google Gemini and Vertex AI | Mira, Meet notes and live assistants, AI Studio | Google Cloud invoice | Cloud Billing detailed export to BigQuery | `COST_GCP_BILLING_EXPORT_SA` (service account: BigQuery Data Viewer on the export dataset, BigQuery Job User) | AI platform |
| Google Cloud and Firebase | OAuth, Calendar, Play Integrity, Firebase Cloud Messaging | Google Cloud invoice | Same billing export | `COST_GCP_BILLING_EXPORT_SA` | Infrastructure |
| OpenAI | ChatGPT provider, speech evaluation | Organization invoice | Costs API `GET /v1/organization/costs` | `COST_OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY` (admin key; no read-only variant, so it lives only in the collector) | AI platform |
| Anthropic | Direct provider in `packages/ai` | Console invoice | Usage and Cost Admin API (the `cost_report` endpoint is legacy; use the current analytics endpoints) | `COST_ANTHROPIC_ADMIN_KEY` (admin key; same isolation) | AI platform |
| Deepgram | Speech to text | Console invoice | Management API `/usage/breakdown` | `COST_DEEPGRAM_API_KEY` (key with usage read scope) | AI platform |
| Modal | Discord bot and speech-to-text jobs | Workspace invoice | None used | Invoice import | AI platform |
| Supermemory | Mira memory | Invoice | None used | Invoice import | AI platform |
| AWS | SES sending and inbound mail, S3 | AWS invoice | Cost Explorer `GetCostAndUsage` (each request is billed, so collect once a day) | `COST_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `COST_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` (IAM `ce:GetCostAndUsage` only) | Infrastructure |
| Upstash | Rate-limit Redis | Invoice | None used | Invoice import | Infrastructure |
| Polar | Billing platform fees | Ledger fee entries | Orders API | Finance ledger export by default. A `COST_POLAR_ACCESS_TOKEN` with `orders:read` can also generate invoices, so it is not read-only | Finance |

| Apple Developer Program | iOS and macOS distribution | Annual membership receipt | None | Finance recurring entry | Mobile release |

Not in use and not costed: Hyperdrive, Workers AI and Vectorize have no
binding; Sentry, PostHog, Stripe, Resend, Postmark and SendGrid have no call
sites. Groq, Mistral, xAI, DeepSeek, Perplexity, Fireworks, Together, DeepInfra
and Cohere SDKs are dependencies only, reached through AI Gateway model IDs, so
their spend appears in Gateway credits.

## Collector design (proposed)

Scheduled collection is to run on Cloudflare, following the
[backend ownership guard](https://github.com/tutur3u/platform/blob/main/docs-internal/build/devops/cloudflare-backend-ownership.mdx).
Each run reads a fixed number of provider-days per provider, writes idempotent
rows keyed by provider, account and source line identity, and checks a durable
stop fence before every provider call. A day that fails is left for the next
scheduled run instead of retrying in a loop.

Each provider call also has a request budget. A one-day window bounds the
dates, but a paginated response can still cost several requests: AWS Cost
Explorer bills each paginated request. A window that would exceed its budget
records that provider-day as budget-exhausted, a terminal state that later
runs skip until its query or budget changes, so an oversized window cannot
charge the same pages again.

The Vercel charges endpoint returned about 620,000 daily rows (about 480 MB)
for four months, so the collector requests one day per call, caps the
response and aggregates by service and project before writing.

## Unit economics denominators

| Unit | Denominator source |
| --- | --- |
| Active workspace or user | Session and engagement sources used by the Executive overview |
| AI request | `ai_credit_transactions`, `private.ai_studio_usage`, `private.ai_live_sessions` |
| Meet minute | `public.meet_ai_sessions`, `meet_ai_chunks.duration_seconds`, `private.meet_attendance_sessions`, presence intervals from `packages/realtime/src/meet/room-budget.ts` |
| Metered workspace usage | `private.usage_meter_periods` (`sandbox_seconds`, `participant_seconds`, `stored_bytes`, `transfer_bytes`) |

`attributedUnitCost` divides posted, reconciled cost attributed to a target by
a complete denominator for the same provider, account, target and window.
Estimates cannot feed it; an estimate-based unit cost must be labeled as an
estimate and computed separately.

## Coverage gaps

These need a credential or an invoice before Admin can show a figure:

- Cloudflare: `COST_CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN`.
- Supabase: `COST_SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN` for inventory, and organization
  invoices imported through the Finance invoice flow.
- Google Cloud, Gemini, Vertex and Firebase: billing export to BigQuery enabled
  on the billing account, then `COST_GCP_BILLING_EXPORT_SA`.
- OpenAI and Anthropic: `COST_OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY`, `COST_ANTHROPIC_ADMIN_KEY`.
- Vercel AI Gateway: credit top-up receipts through the Finance invoice flow.
- Polar: the Finance ledger export.
- AWS: `COST_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` and `COST_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`.
- Deepgram: `COST_DEEPGRAM_API_KEY`.
- Invoice-only providers (Modal, Supermemory, Upstash, SePay, Apple, Google
  Play, code signing, domains, Google Workspace, developer SaaS): import each
  invoice through the Finance invoice flow.

The AI executions cost view prices tokens per million from a fixed Gemini rate
table in `ai/executions/utils/cost-calculator.ts` (web and workspace). It is a
rate-model estimate for that page only and is not a provider cost source.
